$doc: E387 progress cameras for scripts/shard-progress.mjs: the loop builders' hero views (H1 Sunrest rim, H2 the windmill isle, H3 the high step, H4 the crown) plus two aerials and an orbit clip. Keep them fixed: the time-lapse lines frames up by id. yaw / pitch in degrees (yaw 0 faces -z). E399: one mock-* view per council mockup (docs/plans/mockup-council/ledger.md), at the mockup's camera: proposal B and mockup A down the spawn bridge to the windmill, B the quest start at the spawn (the keeper left of the axis), C the fan with the windmill behind, D the crown arena under the Roc. The spawn mock views come before the crown (its boss bar) and the aerials (a god view hides the viewmodel). Re-aimed to the mockups' cameras (E399 round notes): B 5.5 m from the keeper with the windmill just right of him; proposal B, A and C on the bridge's axis before its posts, out of the keeper's 3.5 m talk range and the phone's ~24 deg-wide frame; D from 18 m before the dais, the Roc staged mid-stalk over the dais (stage 'roc-stalk', settle 0.3 s).
